authoring_diagnostics.summary: The Procedure source violates the closed v2 authoring schema.
The source uses an unsupported YAML or JSON construct.
The complete canonical source projection exceeds 131,072 characters.
The complete generated graph text projection exceeds 131,072 characters.
The source is not in canonical authoring form.
The graph entry is missing or does not name a graph node.
A graph placement names an unknown node definition.
A transition names an unknown graph node.
A graph node is unreachable from the entry.
A reachable graph region has no finite path to a terminal action.
An action placement does not declare exactly one of next or terminal.
A decision option has no route.
A route names an undefined decision option.
A goal-assessment option has no outcome mapping.
A goal-assessment option maps to an unknown outcome.
A required goal-assessment outcome has no mapped option.
A session-goal assessment is declared without goal tracking.
A terminal action is not dominated by a session-goal assessment.
An evidence reference names an unknown graph node.
An evidence reference names its consuming placement.
Required evidence is not produced on every path to its consumer.
A required evidence source may be skipped.
An evidence selector names an item absent from its source definition.
Worst-case evidence reference and item metadata exceeds its next allocation.
Worst-case complete decision records exceed their next allocation.
Worst-case evidence previews exceed their next allocation.
Worst-case continuation tokens exceed their next allocation.
The charged next allocations together exceed the frame payload.
Procedure-static next content exceeds its bounded budget.
Declared worst-case recorded content for the placement exceeds the per-attempt aggregate.
A decision placement declares a skip policy.

A declared rework target does not dominate its decision placement.
A manual rework target names an unknown graph node.
A node-definition or graph-placement reference is ambiguous.
A node definition has no graph placement.
A decision exposes only one option.
Decision options have indistinguishable labels.
Decision options have identical effective routes.
Decision option labels have duplicate normalized fingerprints.
Decision option criteria are missing, duplicated, or fail to distinguish equivalent routes.
Procedure purpose guidance is missing or weak.
Node intent guidance is missing or weak.
Decision objective guidance is missing or weak.
Decision prompt guidance is missing or weak.
Option criteria guidance is missing or weak.
Decision reason guidance is missing or weak.
A decision supplies neither evidence references nor evidence guidance.
No path to a consumer can resolve an optional evidence reference.
Goal tracking has no early goal-clarification path.
A goal assessment occurs long before every terminal action.
The manual rework target set is unusually broad.
Equivalent node definitions should be reused.
Graph node identifiers are difficult to distinguish.
The legal rework topology is difficult to review.
The procedure is terminal by design and has no reactivation path.
A manual rework target cannot safely support goal revision.
A placement references more than one goal-assessment source.
